ketu_mahadasha.hauptthemen: Detachment, spiritual awakening, hidden abilities from past lives, isolation, unexpected changes, health shaped by psychosomatic factors, mystical experiences.

venus_mahadasha.hauptthemen: Pleasure, luxury, love and partnership, art and creativity, material prosperity, beauty, social status, balance and harmony. The longest Mahadasha (20 years) — a time of maturity and abundance.

sonne_mahadasha.hauptthemen: Authority, identity, self-expression, a career in public service, relationships with the father, health and vitality, honor and reputation, government and public authorities.

mond_mahadasha.hauptthemen: Emotional life, relationships with the mother, the soul of the people/the public, travel, water and fluids, psychological well-being, home and nourishment, intuition, change and adaptation.

mars_mahadasha.hauptthemen: Energy, fighting spirit, real estate and landed property, relationships with siblings, engineering and surgery, conflict and assertiveness, sexuality and passion, military/athletic activities.

rahu_mahadasha.hauptthemen: Ambition and advancement by unconventional routes, ties to foreign lands, technology and modernity, deception and illusion, obsessions, sudden leaps and falls, collective influences, karmic themes.

jupiter_mahadasha.hauptthemen: Wisdom and growth, children and descendants, education and teaching, spirituality and dharma, prosperity and good fortune, journeys to holy places, philosophy of life, social recognition through integrity.

saturn_mahadasha.hauptthemen: Fulfillment of karma, hard work and perseverance, limitations and lessons, longevity and health through discipline, low status/advancement through effort, the elderly and ancestors, isolation and trials.

merkur_mahadasha.hauptthemen: Intellect and communication, trade and business, writing and language, education and logic, relatives (siblings, cousins), travel and transport, analytical thinking, medicine and mathematics.

ketu_ketu.beschreibung: Isolation and the spiritual search dominate. Withdrawal, inner wandering, unclear direction. Transformation through detachment.

ketu_venus.beschreibung: Ketu-Venus: letting go of pleasure and relationships. Mystical love vs. worldly attachment. Artistic inspiration, but conflict in relationships.

ketu_sonne.beschreibung: Dissolution of the ego. Conflicts with authorities and the father. An identity crisis with potential for spiritual maturing. Health needs attention.

ketu_mond.beschreibung: Psychic sensitivity is extremely heightened. Emotional confusion, issues with the mother. Spiritual dreams and visions. Nervous exhaustion possible.

ketu_mars.beschreibung: Both of a Martian nature (Ketu acts like Mars). Energy for spiritual discipline. Engineering and surgery, a struggle for inner truth. Risk of accidents.

ketu_rahu.beschreibung: The nodal axis is activated — maximum karmic confrontation. Chaotic turns, loss of identity, deceptions. Rare moments of enlightenment possible.

ketu_jupiter.beschreibung: The best Antardasha in the Ketu period. Spiritual wisdom through a guru. Religious practice deepens. Protection by higher powers. Enlightenment in dharma.

ketu_saturn.beschreibung: Deep dissolution of karma through privation. Isolation and discipline. Spiritual work through limitation. Chronic health matters should be checked.

ketu_merkur.beschreibung: Intuition meets intellect. Hidden knowledge, occult sciences. Communication becomes deeper, but also less clear. Interesting for research.

venus_venus.beschreibung: Double Venus energy — maximum pleasure and prosperity. Marriage, luxury, art. A social high point. Beware of arrogance.

venus_sonne.beschreibung: Luxury meets authority. A career in the creative field. Official recognition for art. Tension between personal pleasure and public role.

venus_mond.beschreibung: Romance and emotions at their peak. Motherly care and sensual love. Artistic fertility. Popularity with the public.

venus_mars.beschreibung: Passion and conflict in relationships. Intense sexuality. Acquisition of real estate possible. Scenes of jealousy and power in love.

venus_rahu.beschreibung: Unconventional relationships and exotic luxury. Foreign ties in love/art. Alluring but unstable connections. Deception in finances.

venus_jupiter.beschreibung: Guru-Shukra: an ideal combination for prosperity. Dharma and pleasure. Marriage based on values. Financial expansion through ethical conduct.

venus_saturn.beschreibung: Slow but steady building of prosperity. Relationships through duty and maturity. Venus-Saturn: artistic discipline. Late ripening in relationships.

venus_merkur.beschreibung: Art and intellect combine. Creative writing, music and communication flourish. A talent for trade. Beautiful language and aesthetic thinking.

venus_ketu.beschreibung: Spiritual detachment from pleasure. Creativity meets asceticism. Romantic illusions dissolve. A guardian angel in moments of separation.

sonne_sonne.beschreibung: Double solar power: authority and recognition come to the fore, but so do pride, conflicts with superiors and strain on the eyes, heart and the body's heat balance.

sonne_mond.beschreibung: Sun and Moon as natural friends: honor, growth in possessions, support from the family and good relationships; favorable for marriage and public presence.

sonne_mars.beschreibung: Friendly forces: drive, courage and success in your career, gains from landed property; a tendency toward quarrels, fevers and minor injuries.

sonne_rahu.beschreibung: Rahu darkens the Sun: tension with authorities, deception, uncertainty in your career and weakened health; unusual paths, including abroad.

sonne_jupiter.beschreibung: Friendship of Sun and Jupiter: honor, prosperity, support from teachers and superiors, happiness with children, religious and spiritual maturity.

sonne_saturn.beschreibung: The strongest natural enmity: conflicts with the father and with authorities, losses, obstacles in your career and lingering illnesses.

sonne_merkur.beschreibung: Sun and Mercury work together: learning, trade, skillful communication and recognition for intellectual work; nervousness and skin problems possible.

sonne_ketu.beschreibung: Ketu separates: withdrawal, loss of position or possessions, strain on the head and eyes; at the same time a spiritual search and pilgrimage.

sonne_venus.beschreibung: Opposing forces: comfort, art and relationships bring joy, but also friction in the partnership and spending on luxury.

mond_mond.beschreibung: Full lunar power: emotional depth, a sense of security, closeness to the mother and popularity; mood swings and changing plans.

mond_mars.beschreibung: Moon and Mars: drive and gains from property, but irritability, quarrels in the family and strain from heat and blood.

mond_rahu.beschreibung: Rahu clouds the Moon: restlessness, anxieties, confusion and misunderstandings; unfamiliar encounters and journeys.

mond_jupiter.beschreibung: Moon and Jupiter: wisdom, prosperity, standing and joy through children and teachers; inner calm and generosity.

mond_saturn.beschreibung: Saturn weighs on the Moon: dejection, loneliness, worries about the mother and slow progress; maturity through hardship.

mond_merkur.beschreibung: Moon and Mercury: learning, communication and trade go well; new contacts and pleasure in intellectual work, at times nervous restlessness.

mond_ketu.beschreibung: Ketu loosens emotional bonds: losses, withdrawal and uncertainty in the family; a turn toward spirituality.

mond_venus.beschreibung: Moon and Venus: coziness, love, art, beautiful things and pleasant company; spending on comfort.

mond_sonne.beschreibung: Moon and Sun as friends: support from superiors and the father, recognition and a clear will; go easy on your eyes.

mars_mars.beschreibung: Double Martian power: assertiveness, landed property and athletic ambition, but quarrels, accidents and risk of injury.

mars_rahu.beschreibung: Mars and Rahu: sudden events, aggression, lawsuits and risk of accidents; courage in risky ventures.

mars_jupiter.beschreibung: Mars and Jupiter as friends: righteous action, success, landed property and prosperity, happiness with children and teachers.

mars_saturn.beschreibung: Mars and Saturn as adversaries: hard trials, accidents, operations, conflicts and losses; endurance pays off late.

mars_merkur.beschreibung: Mars is hostile to Mercury: disputes over words and contracts, nervous tension and skin problems; skill in trade under pressure.

mars_ketu.beschreibung: Ketu acts like Mars: intense, sudden energy, operations possible, separations; courage and spiritual discipline.

mars_venus.beschreibung: Mars and Venus: passion, relationships, art and pleasure, but impulsiveness, jealousy and spending.

mars_sonne.beschreibung: Mars and Sun as friends: courage, recognition, leadership roles and success with authorities; watch out for heat and headaches.

mars_mond.beschreibung: Mars and Moon: gains, possessions and support from the family; changing moods and an urge to act.

rahu_rahu.beschreibung: Double Rahu: ambition, confusion, deception and sudden ups and downs; foreign countries and unusual surroundings.

rahu_jupiter.beschreibung: Jupiter in the Rahu period: growth along unconventional paths, patrons and teachers, gains and spiritual direction.

rahu_saturn.beschreibung: Rahu acts like Saturn: hard work, delays, work abroad or with foreigners; success through perseverance.

rahu_merkur.beschreibung: Rahu and Mercury: sharp wits, technology, trade and communication go well; learning new things, caution with deception.

rahu_ketu.beschreibung: The axis of the lunar nodes under tension: confusion, losses, separation and uncertain health.

rahu_venus.beschreibung: Rahu and Venus: luxury, relationships, art and sudden gains; temptations and excess possible.

rahu_sonne.beschreibung: Rahu eclipses the Sun: conflicts with authorities and the father, uncertainty about your own position, weaker health.

rahu_mond.beschreibung: Rahu and Moon: emotional restlessness, anxieties and sleep problems; worries about the mother, much movement.

rahu_mars.beschreibung: Rahu and Mars: aggression, quarrels, accidents and legal matters; risky ventures with sudden outcomes.

jupiter_jupiter.beschreibung: The guru's blessing twice over. A spiritual high, expanding wisdom, children, education. The greatest period of growth in the Jupiter Dasha.

jupiter_saturn.beschreibung: Growth through discipline. Dharma meets karma. Philosophical trials. Religious duty. Long-term spiritual maturing.

jupiter_merkur.beschreibung: A high point for education. Teaching and learning. Philosophical and intellectual unfolding. Writing. Guru-disciple relationships.

jupiter_ketu.beschreibung: Spiritual wisdom through the principle of moksha. Intuitive enlightenment. Withdrawal and philosophical deepening. Pilgrimages.

jupiter_venus.beschreibung: Guru-Shukra: an ideal combination of wisdom and beauty. Marriage, children, prosperity and spiritual joy combined.

jupiter_sonne.beschreibung: Guru-Surya: dharma and leadership. Religious authority. Success in government through integrity. A career peak through virtue.

jupiter_mond.beschreibung: Gajakesari potential activated. Emotional and intellectual balance. Public recognition through wisdom. Healing with regard to the mother.

jupiter_mars.beschreibung: Guru-Mangala: strength through dharma. Religious courage. Acquisition of real estate for religious reasons. Athletic and spiritual discipline combined.

jupiter_rahu.beschreibung: Guru-Rahu: risk of Chandala Yoga (the guru disturbed by Rahu). Unconventional wisdom. Foreign ties in religion. Deception by a guru possible.

saturn_saturn.beschreibung: The deepest karmic period. Maximum limitation, but also maximum building for the future. Chronic trials. Monastic energy.

saturn_merkur.beschreibung: Analytical mastery. Disciplined thinking. Structured communication. A career in science, law, architecture.

saturn_ketu.beschreibung: Double force of separation. Extreme isolation, trials of health, spiritual depth through hardship. Dissolution of karma through suffering.

saturn_venus.beschreibung: Late blooming in relationships. Material discipline with a sense of beauty. Art through perseverance. Stable finances through diligence.

saturn_sonne.beschreibung: The strongest natural enmity. Conflicts with authorities, problems with the father, career obstacles, heart health should be checked. A karmic harvest.

saturn_mond.beschreibung: Depression and emotional exhaustion. Loss of or separation from the mother. Psychological strain. Maturing through grief. Isolation.

saturn_mars.beschreibung: Two malefics — severe trials. Accidents, operations, conflicts, legal problems. Enormous endurance once overcome.

saturn_rahu.beschreibung: Chaos and restriction. Problems connected with foreign lands. Deception through patience. Yet it can set off deep changes in your career.

saturn_jupiter.beschreibung: Dharma through discipline. Religious duty fulfilled. Spiritual maturing through trials. Philosophical depth. Karmic balance through wisdom.

merkur_merkur.beschreibung: Full Mercurial power: intellect, learning, trade, writing and communication thrive; friendships and a good income.

merkur_ketu.beschreibung: Ketu in the Mercury period: a turning away from the purely rational, research and depth; nervous tension and misunderstandings.

merkur_venus.beschreibung: Mercury and Venus as friends: art, love, prosperity and pleasant company; creative success.

merkur_sonne.beschreibung: Mercury and Sun as friends: recognition for knowledge and skill, support from superiors and authorities.

merkur_mond.beschreibung: Mercury and Moon: feeling and reason pull in different directions; popularity and contacts, but restlessness and nervousness.

merkur_mars.beschreibung: Mercury and Mars: quarrels, sharp words, lawsuits and risk of accidents; getting your way in technical and manual work.

merkur_rahu.beschreibung: Mercury and Rahu: cleverness, technology and unusual ideas, but deception, restlessness and misunderstandings.

merkur_jupiter.beschreibung: Mercury and Jupiter: learning and teaching, wisdom, counsel and prosperity; standing through knowledge.

merkur_saturn.beschreibung: Mercury and Saturn as friends: disciplined work, consolidation in your career, careful planning and lasting results.
